items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: They had Cooney, John, they had Man and Boy, that was the four brothers that played music.

ctx.x: How was he related to you or your father?
He was a half brother of mine, on my father's side. Now there was John, there was another brother by the name of Cooney, and there was another brother by the name of Boy.
Those are brothers of yours, not your father's?
